subject: MAP weekly: evaluation & acceptance rollforward — Adept Health POC
summary: Weekly mutual action plan update for Adept Health POC. Tracks milestone progress, acceptance criteria clarifications, outstanding compliance items, blockers and owners. Next meeting scheduled; procurement timeline noted.
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@adepthealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP weekly: evaluation & acceptance rollforward — Adept Health POC

Hi Sarah —

Quick weekly rollforward on the MAP for the Adept Health POC. High-level status below, followed by concrete asks for this week.

Status (this week):
- Milestone A (data ingest + initial model run) — COMPLETE. We ingested the test dataset and ran baseline evals; 95th percentile latency observed at ~220ms in sandbox with token limit 1024.
- Milestone B (secure evaluation + SSO) — IN PROGRESS; SSO test scheduled but not yet executed.
- Milestone C (acceptance ran) — awaiting your formal acceptance criteria confirmation.

Current blockers:
1) Procurement needs rate-card confirmation for dedicated trial (procurement@adepthealth.com).
2) SOC2 evidence request still open — we sent a summary but procurement wants the scope clarified.
3) SSO test failures in one environment (dev cluster-3) — causes: clock skew / cert chain.

Asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm the acceptance criteria matrix by EOD Wednesday (I attached a working sheet)? We want to lock on pass/fail thresholds for throughput and regression thresholds for generation quality.
- Please confirm procurement’s preferred start date for the dedicated trial window; Marcus can provide a short price/runbook.
- If possible, please schedule the SSO window (30–45min) with your IT team so Rishi and Marcus can join to debug.

Attachments: Adept_MAP_v1.xlsx, eval-cases.csv

Proposed next meetup: Thu, Feb 25, 10:30am PT — 30 minutes.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@adepthealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Adept Health Procurement <procurement@adepthealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP weekly: evaluation & acceptance rollforward — Adept Health POC

Kimberly —

Thanks for the overview and congrats on Milestone A. A couple notes from our side:

- Procurement: we need a line-item rate card for the dedicated trial (including burst hours) by EOD Tuesday. They want to see per-token and per-hour GPU pricing.
- Acceptance criteria: I attached our internal evaluation matrix (Adept_eval_matrix.xlsx). For clarity, our primary pass conditions are:
  * Latency: 95th <= 300ms across representative dataset (50k tokens sample)
  * Accuracy/regression: top-line generation BLEU/ROUGE differences within agreed thresholds (we included sample prompts)
  * Data controls: KV cache disabled for customer-bound tests, and all logs masked per PII policy.

- SSO: IT is available Wednesday 2/24 09:00–10:30 PT — please confirm if that works for your team.

We can meet Thu 2/25 10:30am PT to close the week and review the acceptance matrix after you update with the regression thresholds we discussed.

Sarah Jenkins
Head of Data Science
Adept Health

Attachment: Adept_eval_matrix.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@adepthealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP weekly: evaluation & acceptance rollforward — Adept Health POC

Sarah —

Great, thanks for the matrix. Quick clarifications and actions from our side:

- Rate card: Marcus will send a short rate-card PDF by EOD Tuesday (see related link to HubSpot for pricing notes).
- Acceptance thresholds: we propose the following concrete numeric thresholds to make the eval deterministic:
  * Latency: 95th <= 280ms over your provided subset (we prefer a slightly tighter bound to give you headroom).
  * Regression: maximum 4% drop in the primary quality metric across the curated prompt set; any drop >4% triggers a rollback to baseline model.
  * Data controls: we confirm KV cache off and we will redact PII per the masking rules; Rishi will provide a short evidence note.

- SSO: Wednesday 2/24 09:00 PT works for Marcus and Rishi — they will join your IT call for live troubleshooting. Please send an invite.

Action items / owners (updated):
- Marcus Lin: deliver rate card and dedicated-trial runbook — due Tue 2/24 EOD.
- Rishi Malhotra: SOC2 scoping confirmation and PII masking evidence — due Wed 2/25 morning.
- Kimberly Park: update MAP workbook with numeric acceptance thresholds and push to shared Drive — due Tue 2/24 noon.

I attached the updated MAP workbook to this thread after edits. If anything looks off, flag it in Slack or on the Thu call.

Thanks,
Kimberly

Attachment referenced: Adept_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated)

Sarah / Kimberly —

Quick note from Security/Compliance:
- SOC2-summary.pdf attached — this is a two-page scope summary covering our control domains and what we can share with procurement for the POC. It specifically calls out data segregation during dedicated trials and the encryption-in-transit and at-rest controls.
- For the PII masking: we will run a pre-processing step in the dedicated trial that redacts any fields tagged as PHI/PII; I will also provide a short test harness so you can validate masking on a sample.

Blocker to be aware of: procurement wants the SOC2 scope signed off by legal before the rate card is accepted — if possible, can your legal team review the SOC2-summary by Thu EOD?

-Rishi

Thanks everyone —

Confirming the SSO slot tomorrow 2/24 09:00 PT is booked (invites sent). Procurement reviewed the SOC2 summary and flagged one clarifying question (copied procurement on this thread). We will aim to review Marcus’ rate card once legal signs off on the SOC2 scope.

One final note: I updated the acceptance tab in the shared Drive with our sign-off column; Kimberly, please push the updated MAP workbook there after your edits so we can mark Milestone A as accepted and move the trial start to week of 3/2 pending procurement.

Also, I completed the DocuSign intent to proceed — you should see a link in the related links list. If all looks good, we can use the Thu 2/25 10:30am meeting to close the MAP for the POC.
